description:
AUDITED and built from exact base `40563eeb756636153df0aac67d01940864fe2556` (2026-09-06).

## Status

DONE in commit `b5969795f8aaf2d3f39af7c822736a84da2b999f`. Ticket-scoped cold review accepted the exact diff and evidence. Exact CI run `34046911263` is green (lint plus full serialized coverage/test).

## Goal

Make the runtime collection helpers total over their real producer-owned domains. `Enum.member_result/3`, `List.member?/2`, and both private `Enum.with_index_list` arities must declare exactly the values they consume, so exhaustive empty/cons and ok/error clauses are correct by construction. Preserve all valid public behavior; do not suppress diagnostics, add catch-all clauses for impossible values, or infer authority from whichever activations one program happens to create.

## Live defect

The compiler emitted 16 `warning[type/no-matching-clause]` diagnostics across nine fixtures:

- `Enum.member_result/3` lacked the exact `{:ok, bool} | {:error, any}` result domain published by `Enumerable.member?/2`.
- `List.member?/2` declared `any` for its container although its implementation is the list protocol implementation.
- `Enum.with_index_list/2,3` lacked contracts stating that their private inputs are lists.

The historical with-index evidence formerly lived only in a ticket comment. It is now part of this description and acceptance, not an omission.

## Correct-by-construction cut

The source authority declares:

- `member_result({:ok, bool} | {:error, any}, Enumerable.t(a), a) :: bool`;
- `List.member?([a], any) :: bool`, retaining heterogeneous searches such as looking for `:missing` in `[1]`;
- `with_index_list([a], integer) :: [{a, integer}]`;
- `with_index_list([a], integer, (a, integer) -> b) :: [b]`.

One existing production-boundary diagnostic test owns the membership and with-index witnesses together with a genuine user-partiality control.

## Deterministic signal

TDD RED observed eight warnings across the four focused witnesses; GREEN observed zero.

A full 607-source/478-backend-producer sweep measured warnings `94 -> 78`: exactly 16 removals across nine named fixtures, with no added warning or error and zero exit-status/stdout movers. Product requested/evaluated/settled/cache-hit and activation-analysis counts are unchanged. Exact relevant contract derivation adds ten `FunctionContract`, `job.start`, and `work_graph.applied` events and no downstream product work.

Twenty-eight backend dump hashes move only because added declarations shift `runtime:Enum.fz` and Enum/Enumerable lambda source-range provenance. Byte lengths are unchanged; after normalizing only those two exact range classes all 28 pairs are byte-identical. There are zero executable, type, dispatch, inventory, or other semantic artifact movers.

## Removal

Five wholly obsolete warning sidecars are deleted. `enum_map_family.expected.diagnostics` loses only its two with-index blocks. Stale fixture prose about those deleted goldens and gutter workarounds is deleted or restated as present fact. The remaining 13 same-class Enum private-list-walker warnings are owned explicitly by epic-tail fz-tfn.58.

## Durable evidence

The full proof is in `.agent/measurements/fz-kdt.185-runtime-warning-contracts.md`. Ticket attachments preserve the exact sweep and comparison scripts, compressed base/current results, summary, diagnostic/backend/work mover tables, and canonical-range normalization result:

`fz-kdt185-corpus-sweep.py`, `fz-kdt185-compare.py`, `fz-kdt185-retain-canons.py`, `fz-kdt185-normalize-canons.py`, `base-results.json.gz`, `current-results.json.gz`, `summary.json`, `diagnostic-movers.tsv`, `backend-movers.tsv`, `work-movers.tsv`, and `canon-normalization.json`.

## Acceptance

- All 16 named membership/with-index warnings disappear and no diagnostic is added.
- `enum_count_member_reduce`, `enum_list_allocations`, `enum_tier0`, `membership_operator`, `enum_map_family`, and both with-index user fixtures preserve their expected output on every applicable door.
- Heterogeneous membership remains valid; genuine user partial functions still warn.
- No output, product, activation, executable, dispatch, type, or semantic artifact mover occurs.
- Every source-range-only and causal-work mover is deterministically classified.
- Obsolete warning goldens and stale fixture comments are removed.
- Focused tests, formatting, strict all-target/all-feature clippy, doctests, `cargo test --lib`, and the serial fixture matrix pass.
